cases.question: What is the average salary of active employees in each department?
cases.sql:
SELECT
  d.DepartmentName,
  ROUND(AVG(e.Salary), 2) AS AverageSalary
FROM Departments AS d
JOIN Employees AS e
  ON e.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID
WHERE
  e.IsActive = 1
GROUP BY
  d.DepartmentID,
  d.DepartmentName
ORDER BY
  d.DepartmentName

cases.question: Which customers have placed more than 25 orders? Show their first and last names and how many orders they placed.
cases.sql:
SELECT
  c.FirstName,
  c.LastName,
  COUNT(o.OrderID) AS OrderCount
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Orders AS o
  ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
GROUP BY
  c.CustomerID,
  c.FirstName,
  c.LastName
HAVING
  COUNT(o.OrderID) > 25
ORDER BY

cases.question: What was the total revenue per product category in 2025, excluding cancelled and returned orders?
cases.sql:
SELECT
  p.Category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount)), 2) AS TotalRevenue
FROM OrderItems AS oi
JOIN Orders AS o
  ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID
JOIN Products AS p
  ON p.ProductID = oi.ProductID
WHERE
  o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
  AND o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY
  p.Category
ORDER BY
  TotalRevenue DESC
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.Category, ROUND(SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount)), 2) AS Revenue FROM OrderItems AS oi JOIN Orders AS o ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID JOIN Products AS p ON p.ProductID = oi.ProductID WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01' AND o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') GROUP BY p.Category
cases.message: Total revenue per product category in 2025, excluding cancelled and returned orders. It returned 5 rows.
changes: Filtered out cancelled and returned orders
Joined Orders with OrderItems to get quantities and prices
Calculated revenue as Quantity * UnitPrice * (1 - Discount)
Grouped by product category from Products table
Limited to year 2025 using date range on OrderDate
assumptions: Excluding cancelled and returned orders means filtering out those statuses from the Orders table

turns.message: What was the total revenue per product category in 2025, excluding cancelled and returned orders?
turns.sql:
SELECT
  p.Category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.Discount)), 2) AS TotalRevenue
FROM OrderItems AS oi
JOIN Orders AS o
  ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID
JOIN Products AS p
  ON p.ProductID = oi.ProductID
WHERE
  o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
  AND o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

cases.question: Group products into price tiers: Budget (under $50), Standard ($50 to $500) and Premium (over $500). How many products are in each tier?
cases.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN UnitPrice < 50
    THEN 'Budget'
    WHEN UnitPrice <= 500
    THEN 'Standard'
    ELSE 'Premium'
  END AS PriceTier,
  COUNT(*) AS ProductCount
FROM Products
GROUP BY
  PriceTier
ORDER BY
  ProductCount DESC
cases.reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN UnitPrice < 50 THEN 'Budget' WHEN UnitPrice <= 500 THEN 'Standard' ELSE 'Premium' END AS PriceTier, COUNT(*) AS ProductCount FROM Products GROUP BY PriceTier

  CASE
